name: offtopic-quick-fact
why: A quick factual question gets a brief, true, friendly answer, and then it ENDS (19 Nov 2026: the old rule made the coach tack a pivot on, which produced 'Speaking of fluids, how are you doing on your water target today?'). A refusal here is as wrong as a five-paragraph essay, and so is a check-in on something he never raised. A tie to his own numbers is welcome only when it is real and specific.
messages: how many ml in a cup
